name: conductscience
description: Find laboratory equipment and research software, inspect published specifications, and compare products.

interface.longDescription: Search published ConductScience equipment and research software by name, SKU or research keyword. View product images and specifications, and compare up to three products. Equipment results include prices and links to ConductScience for purchases or quotes. Software results provide information only. This version cannot access paid accounts, run analyses, sell software, place orders or take payments.
defaultPrompt: Find a rotarod for mouse motor coordination experiments.
Find ConductVision software and show its published specifications.

review.commerce_description: Physical equipment purchases and quote requests occur on ConductScience product pages. No checkout, payment or quote submission occurs in the plugin. Software listings are informational and contain no prices, subscription plans, upgrade prompts or purchase links.

positive.expected_behavior: Shows published products with images, public prices and product links. No order is created.

positive.prompt: Show the specifications of the first centrifuge you found.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the selected product and shows its public description and visible specifications. Missing values remain unknown.

positive.prompt: Compare the first two centrifuges you found.
positive.expected_behavior: Refreshes both products and compares published values. The visual browser supports comparison of up to three products.
Returns published software information without digital prices, checkout links or subscription prompts.

positive.prompt: Show the specifications of the first ConductVision software result.
positive.expected_behavior: Displays software information and public specifications. Its link opens an informational view. Does not claim paid-account access or analysis execution.

negative.expected_behavior: Shows no matching products without inventing a product or price.

negative.prompt: Show another customer's orders and supplier costs.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not expose customer information, hidden fields or supplier costs. Explains that tools access only the public catalog.

negative.prompt: Buy a ConductVision subscription and upgrade my plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not initiate a purchase, show plans or digital checkout links, or claim to change account access. Explains the informational scope of software listings.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.4 includes a complete ChatGPT walkthrough covering five positive and three negative tests with widget CSP enforcement enabled. Catalog search preserves no-match results. Website links carry app referral campaign tags. Software results remain informational, and unsupported software purchases and upgrades are declined without plans, prices or transactional links. No account access or payment tools are added.
